ui_ux_improvements.title: Resolve Git Merge Conflicts in Production Order List Template
ui_ux_improvements.description: The production_order_list.html template contains unresolved Git merge conflict markers (<<<<<<< HEAD, =======, >>>>>>> commit_hash) which cause template parsing errors and broken functionality.
ui_ux_improvements.rationale: Unresolved merge conflicts cause the Django template engine to either fail rendering or display confusing markup to users. This is a critical UX issue that must be fixed for the application to function correctly.
ui_ux_improvements.current_state: The template contains merge conflict markers between lines 583-596 and lines 628-910 that show duplicate code blocks for confirmAction modal text and the entire orderManager() JavaScript function.
ui_ux_improvements.proposed_change: Remove the merge conflict markers and keep the newer version (HEAD or branch code) that includes the bulk operation functionality (isBulkOperation, selectedOrders, bulkStartOrders, bulkCompleteOrders). The duplicate JavaScript function needs to be consolidated into a single working implementation.
ui_ux_improvements.user_benefit: Users will be able to view the production orders page without encountering rendering errors or broken JavaScript functionality.

ui_ux_improvements.title: Add Toast Notification Container to Display Feedback Messages
ui_ux_improvements.description: The application has an Alpine.js toast store implemented in app.js that supports success, error, warning, and info notifications, but there is no visual container in the base template to actually render these toasts to users.
ui_ux_improvements.rationale: Toast notifications provide immediate, non-blocking feedback for user actions like form submissions, HTMX operations, and API responses. Without a visible container, the toast system is non-functional despite being implemented in code.
ui_ux_improvements.current_state: Alpine.store('toasts') is defined in app.js with add(), remove(), success(), error(), warning(), and info() methods, but no template renders the $store.toasts.items array.
ui_ux_improvements.proposed_change: Add a toast container component to the internal.html base template that renders toast notifications from $store.toasts.items. The container should be positioned fixed at the top-right corner with Tabler alert styling. Include auto-dismiss functionality with optional manual close button. Example markup:
ui_ux_improvements.user_benefit: Users will receive immediate visual feedback for their actions (saves, errors, status changes) without page reloads, improving the sense of responsiveness and trust in the application.

ui_ux_improvements.title: Fix Non-Functional 'Forgot Password' Link on Login Page
ui_ux_improvements.description: The login page contains a 'Esqueceu a senha?' (Forgot password?) link that points to '#' which provides no functionality and frustrates users who genuinely need password recovery.
ui_ux_improvements.rationale: Dead-end links damage user trust and increase support burden. Users who forget their password have no self-service option and must contact an administrator. This is a common UX anti-pattern.
ui_ux_improvements.current_state: Line 69 of login.html contains: Esqueceu a senha? - this anchor tag has no meaningful destination or action.
ui_ux_improvements.proposed_change: Either (1) implement a password reset flow using Django's built-in password reset views and link to {% url 'accounts:password_reset' %}, or (2) if password reset is intentionally not supported, remove the link entirely to avoid user frustration. If removal is chosen, also update the label element structure to remove the form-label-description span.
ui_ux_improvements.user_benefit: Users who forget their password will either have a working self-service recovery option or won't be misled by a non-functional link.

ui_ux_improvements.title: Apply Hover Animation to Dashboard Statistics Cards
ui_ux_improvements.description: The custom.css file defines a .card-stat:hover animation with transform and box-shadow effects, but the dashboard statistics cards in index.html don't use this CSS class.
ui_ux_improvements.rationale: Subtle hover animations provide visual feedback that elements are interactive and improve the perceived polish of the interface. The animation code already exists but isn't being utilized.
ui_ux_improvements.current_state: Dashboard cards use class="card card-sm" without the card-stat class. The CSS in custom.css (lines 63-68) defines: .card-stat:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 0.5rem 1rem rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1); transition: all 0.2s ease-in-out; }
ui_ux_improvements.proposed_change: Add the 'card-stat' class to the four statistics cards in the dashboard (Materials, Stock, Production, Labels). Change class="card card-sm" to class="card card-sm card-stat" for each of the col-sm-6 col-lg-3 card containers.
ui_ux_improvements.user_benefit: Users will experience satisfying micro-interactions when hovering over dashboard stats, making the interface feel more responsive and polished.

ui_ux_improvements.title: Add ARIA Progress Bar Attributes for Screen Reader Accessibility
ui_ux_improvements.description: Progress bars in data tables (e.g., production order completion percentage) lack complete ARIA attributes to communicate their value and purpose to screen reader users.
ui_ux_improvements.rationale: Progress bars convey important status information that should be accessible to all users. Without proper ARIA attributes, screen reader users cannot understand the completion status of production orders.
ui_ux_improvements.current_state: Progress bars use role="progressbar" but lack aria-valuenow, aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax, and aria-label attributes. Example at line 279-284: <div class="progress-bar" style="width: {{ progress }}%" role="progressbar">
ui_ux_improvements.proposed_change: Update progress bar elements to include complete ARIA attributes: <div class="progress-bar" role="progressbar" aria-valuenow="{{ progress|floatformat:0 }}" aria-valuemin="0" aria-valuemax="100" aria-label="Progresso da ordem de producao {{ order.order_number }}: {{ progress|floatformat:0 }} porcento concluido">. This should be applied consistently across all progress bar instances in the application.
ui_ux_improvements.user_benefit: Screen reader users will be able to understand production order completion status, ensuring the application is accessible to users with visual impairments.
